landing.title: Leave your mark on those you love
landing.intro: Write messages for the people you care about most — and receive theirs. They arrive at the exact moment they're needed, even after you're gone.
landing.exampleBody: “When you turn 18, I want you to know how proud I am of the person you're becoming…”
landing.step1Body: Text, audio or a short video, at your own pace and in your own words.
landing.step2Body: A special date, or simply "when I'm gone".
landing.step3Body: People you trust confirm when it should be delivered.
landing.lifeTitle: And in the meantime, share your life
landing.pageBody: A cover photo, your motto and a place where family and friends leave you messages.
landing.storiesBody: Photos and short videos that last 24 hours, seen only by the followers you approve.
landing.petsBody: A page for each pet: an album while they're with you and a memorial when they're gone.
landing.datesBody: Birthdays and anniversaries, with a reminder on the day.
landing.trustTitle: Designed so nothing is delivered too soon
landing.trustBody: We choose calm over haste. Every step is designed so your words arrive when they should, and only then.
landing.safeguard1: Your guardians are people with an Akashia account, not just an email address.
landing.safeguard2: With several guardians, at least two confirmations are required.
landing.safeguard3: After confirmation there are 48 hours to cancel if it was a mistake.
landing.safeguard4: Your messages are kept private until the time comes.
landing.startTitle: Start today, at your own pace
landing.startBody: Creating your account is free. Write your first message, invite your guardians and rest easy.
landing.footerNote: 2026 · made with care for those we love

install.cardBody: Install it and open it from your screen with one tap, like any app.
install.iosIntro: On iPhone and iPad, Apple doesn’t allow installing with a single button. It takes three taps:
install.ios1: Tap the Share button (a square with an arrow pointing up). If you don’t see it, tap the three dots first.
install.ios2: Choose “Add to Home Screen”. You may need to scroll down the list.
install.android1: Open your browser menu (the three dots or three lines).
install.android2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.desktop1: Click the install icon at the end of the address bar.
install.desktop2: If it isn’t there, open the browser menu. In Chrome: “Cast, save, and share”, then “Install page as app”. In Edge: “Apps”, then “Install this site as an app”.
install.mac1: In the top bar, open the File menu.
install.inApp: You’re viewing Akashia inside another app, and it can’t be installed from there. Copy the address and open it in Chrome or Safari.
install.firefox: To install it on your computer, copy the address and open it in Chrome or Edge.
install.already: If you already installed it, look for it on your home screen or among your apps.
